name: undefined Block
purpose: Expose a lean import workflow while the backend owns templates, header checks, row validation, and commit.
invariants: Blocks expose lean controls and standardized outputs.
Blocks import Dysium System* exports and never provider internals.
Hidden admin and all-forms access must not clutter normal workflow blocks.

contract.job: Expose a lean import workflow while the backend owns templates, header checks, row validation, and commit.
contract.incomingHandoff: Operator has a data file and needs deterministic import proof.
contract.outgoingHandoff: Records are committed or blocked with row-level reasons.

validationBehavior.blockedState: Rows remain preview-only until validation passes and the operator commits.

roleVisibility.rule: Workflow users see only task controls and standardized outputs; System Manager keeps full DocType access in hidden all-forms admin.
